summary: This Layer 2B pass maps ticker relationships for a mixed Consumer candidate chunk spanning private-label food manufacturing, travel transaction rails, corporate travel workflows, housing-service software, real estate data/marketplaces, and title/settlement rails. Because the supplied external evidence is strongest for retail EDI networks and omnichannel supply-chain software rather than this exact chunk, most ticker relationships remain hypothesis-stage and require filing-level verification before promotion. The most structurally relevant nodes appear to be travel transaction rails, property-management/rent-payment workflows, and regulated housing transaction rails. THS is a possible second-order private-label beneficiary but requires evidence that retailer private-label volume and service-level execution are improving. BGS, SABR, EVCM, PRCH, FAF, and STC carry higher cyclicality, leverage, or housing/travel macro sensitivity and should be treated as evidence-gated candidates rather than confirmed chokepoints.
